intro.title: Walk with Jesus
intro.body: Jesus is traveling with His followers. Stay near Him as He leads you toward a teaching about love of neighbor and mercy.

stops.title: A question on the road
stops.body: A scholar asks Jesus what it means to love your neighbor. Jesus turns the question into an invitation to listen and reflect.
stops.prompt: How will you enter this teaching?

choices.label: Listen closely
choices.response: You quiet your thoughts and give the teaching your full attention.

choices.label: Ask what love requires
choices.response: You begin listening for a form of love that becomes practical action.

stops.title: Someone is suffering
stops.body: In the story Jesus tells, a traveler has been attacked and left wounded beside the road. The need is real, but stopping may feel costly or unsafe.

choices.label: His immediate need
choices.response: Compassion begins by seeing a person rather than an interruption.

choices.label: The danger around him
choices.response: You recognize the risk and consider how to help wisely without turning away.

stops.title: Mercy crosses the road
stops.body: Others see the wounded traveler and pass by. A Samaritan sees him, draws near, and responds with compassion.
stops.prompt: What would move you from concern to action?

choices.label: Approach and help
choices.response: You choose presence first—drawing near enough to understand what is needed.

choices.label: Bring others to help
choices.response: You choose not to walk away; you look for safe, practical help and remain involved.

stops.title: Care has a cost
stops.body: The Samaritan gives time, supplies, transportation, and continued care. Mercy becomes more than a feeling—it becomes a commitment.
stops.prompt: What can you offer when someone needs care?

choices.label: Share what I have
choices.response: You recognize that ordinary resources can become instruments of mercy.

choices.label: Stay and make a plan
choices.response: You choose patient responsibility rather than a hurried gesture.

stops.title: Go and live mercifully
stops.body: Jesus' teaching makes neighbor-love concrete: notice suffering, draw near, and let compassion become action. Carry that invitation into the choices you make beyond this road.
